name: lecturedoc2
description: LectureDoc2 - the presentation framework. Browser runtime only: the CSS and the ES modules a finished deck loads. Everything that runs in Node at authoring time lives in `lecturedoc2-author`.
//: No `exports` on purpose: nothing here is imported as a module. These files are *assets* - they are copied to the website next to the generated decks, which is what `files` describes and what `ld2 publish` acts on.
